title: Normalized margin as a linear form
statement:
For every natural number $n$ and every sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the normalized sum of its coordinates equals the linear form with every coefficient equal to $n^{-1/2}$:
\[\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i=\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{x_i}{\sqrt n}.\]
